integrity: The proof reconstructs Mori's two monodromy-invariant multiplicities from the inspected version-1 source, subtracts them to obtain a nonnegative integer sum, and derives the filling equalities from the source's rank and handle formulas. The finite checker is only a regression test and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is planar and integral. It does not classify null-evaluated vanishing cycles, distinguish fillings with equal defect, or extend the formula to higher-genus pages or rational trivializations.
title: A zero-one defect law for planar Calabi-Yau factorizations
